note: In Peter Lougheed PP just north of the earthen Pocaterra Hydroelectric Dam on Lower Kananaskis Lake, beside the Canyon day-use area (boat launch, fish cleaning): larger sites on open grass, smaller sites in the trees, with hiking, mountain-bike and paved bike trails. Food lockers for cyclists. --Claude
